snippet.title: Interstellar Strike Team - VR Game for Meta Quest - Teaser
snippet.description:
Now available for Meta Quest 2/3/3s:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/interstellar-strike-team/8480753702007270/

Join an interstellar strike team and fight together with up to three other players against alien robots. Control the systems of your battleship, climb into an interceptor for space combat or land on planets to fight the robots face-to-face. Unlock more fighters and equipment, earn credits, badges, and promotions.

Community and more:
https://interstellarstriketeam.com/
